response.sql: WITH tx AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, t.amount, t.type FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE t.date >= '1996-05-09' AND t.date <= '1998-01-06'), regional AS (SELECT region, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed, COUNT(*) AS n_trans FROM tx GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS overall_avg FROM regional) SELECT r.region, r.avg_signed, r.n_trans, r.avg_signed / o.overall_avg AS ratio FROM regional r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: trans.date is stored as ISO text 'YYYY-MM-DD', so the string bounds '1996-05-09' and '1998-01-06' select the requested range. The schema does not state the format of trans.date.

A region with no PRIJEM or VYDAJ transactions in the range gets a NULL average and ratio. It still appears as a row, and it is left out of the overall average because AVG ignores NULL. Regions with no transactions at all in the range do not appear.

alternatives.interpretation: trans.date is stored in the YYMMDD form the documentation gives for other date fields, so the bounds are the text '960509' and '980106'.
